note: split v3: supersedes v2 (and v1) after the M2 pre-training review (C1, N1), before any model selection; roles are a pure function of (lon, lat, date) + HydroLAKES

rule.anchor: lake pour point (Pour_long/Pour_lat) for lake points, else the point itself
